title: Hope, Signals, and Silicon: A Game-Theoretic Model of the Pre-Doctoral Academic Labor Market in the Age of AI
abstract: arXiv:2511.00068v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI can make early research work easier to produce and harder to interpret. This paper develops a compact game-theoretic model of this production evaluation tension in the pre-doctoral academic labor market. In the model, PIs organize RA labor, allocate AI between routine and novel tasks, and choose mentoring intensity. RAs choose effort, while admissions committees infer research potential from noisy task-level signals under fixed admissions capacity. A mechanism-preserving simulation examines whether the model's qualitative mechanisms continue to hold when RAs and PIs are heterogeneous, research outcomes partly depend on luck, admissions evaluation is noisy, and elite Ph.D. capacity is fixed. The analysis yields three implications. First, routine task AI can increase observable routine output while reducing the diagnostic precision of routine evidence. translated_title: 希望、信号与硅：AI时代博士前学术劳动力市场的博弈论模型
translated_abstract: 生成式AI可以使早期研究工作更容易产出，但也更难以解读。本文针对博士前学术劳动力市场中的这一生产-评估张力，构建了一个紧凑的博弈论模型。在该模型中，主要研究者（PIs）组织研究助理（RA）劳动力，将AI分配于常规任务和新型任务之间，并选择指导强度。研究助理选择努力程度，而招生委员会在固定招生容量下，从带有噪声的任务级信号中推断研究潜力。一项机制保持的模拟检验了当研究助理和主要研究者具有异质性、研究结果部分依赖运气、招生评估存在噪声以及精英博士项目容量固定时，模型的定性机制是否仍然成立。分析得出三个启示：第一，常规任务AI可以增加可观察的常规产出，同时降低常规证据的诊断精确性；第二，异质的主要研究者目标和任务互补性可能导致……
tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型揭示，生成式AI在博士前学术劳动力市场中虽能提升常规研究产出，却削弱了评估信号的可诊断性，并受异质性目标与固定精英博士容量的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a game-theoretic model to show that generative AI boosts routine research output in the pre-doctoral labor market but reduces the diagnostic precision of signals, influenced by heterogeneous goals and fixed elite Ph.D. capacity.
